tagline: A wellness-led clinic with a Folium dispensary and a long lifestyle blog. Publishes broadly, earns from very few pages — the blog is bloat and the cannabis intent sits underweighted.

eeat.notes: Practitioner pages signal credibility but the clinical content layer is thin. Wellness positioning keeps risk low at the cost of focus. Schema and authorship signals lag the bigger players.
